summary: SSE two-point linear interpolation helper. Loads the high 2-vector of a2 as the interpolation origin, then computes a1 = a2 + (a3 - a2)*a5 + (a4 - a2)*a6 using packed SSE multiply/add/sub on two-point vectors, where a5 and a6 are unsigned ints broadcast to a scalar via shuffle. Stores the high result back into a1 and returns a1. No fields, globals, guards, callees or callers are evidenced in the packet.

local_names.a5: unsigned weight broadcast for (a3 - a2) term
local_names.a6: unsigned weight broadcast for (a4 - a2) term

operations.description: Load high 2-vector of a2 into SSE register as the base value v6.
Compute a2 + (a3 - a2)*a5 + (a4 - a2)*a6 via packed SSE sub/mul/add, broadcasting a5 and a6 as scalar weights.
Store high 2-vector of the computed result into a1 and return a1.

clean_pseudocode: result = v6 + (loadh(a3) - v6) * broadcast((float)a5) + (loadh(a4) - v6) * broadcast((float)a6);
